purpose_context: The Gherkin feature (generated pages, fences, includes) shipped with about 4,700 test lines that overlap across layers, plus five known gaps: mis-cased status shorthands publish silently, draft-only directories get no index, hub titles cannot spell acronyms, llms.txt can advertise a missing scenario index, and one example feature is copied three times with no parity check. This mission closes the gaps test-first, then trims the suite so each behaviour has one owning guard.
purpose_tldr: Trim overlapping Gherkin tests and fix five small Gherkin defects before the next stable release.
